target_statement.summary: On a Euclidean chart domain (dimension d, chart model Vec d := Fin d -> RR), construct the Riemannian density rho = sqrt(det g) from a smooth positive-definite metric matrix g, prove its regularity/measurability, build the Riemannian measure dvol = withDensity volume rho, and prove (a) the chart divergence theorem with compact support and (b) the metric integration-by-parts identity int u * (Delta_g v) dvol = - int <grad u, grad v>_{g^-1} dvol for compactly supported u, which is the identity consumed by the entropy/Bochner chains. Plus (c) a chart change-of-variables statement via mathlib's Jacobian API.
target_statement.formal_centerpiece: chart_ibp : for compactly supported C^2 u and C^2 v, int_x u x * (Delta_g v x) * rho x = - int_x (metricInnerInverse G x (grad u x) (grad v x)) * rho x, with Delta_g v = rho^-1 * sum_i d_i(rho * g^-1_ij * d_j v), proved from MeasureTheory.integral_divergence_of_hasFDerivAt_off_countable (no assumed divergence theorem)
target_statement.semantic_class: model (Euclidean chart of a Riemannian metric), feeding conditional transfer to closed manifolds; global manifold/Stokes gaps stay explicit
